title: Newsroom-style changelog hub and per-release files
summary: Release history now lives as one file per version with a Newsroom-style expandable change log hub, database projection on deploy, and safer public/internal isolation.
changes: Split published history into changelog/releases/vX.Y.Z.json files with lossless conversion from the legacy aggregate.
Added an additive releases table and deterministic myapes:releases-sync that sets current from VERSION and fails closed on missing history.
Routed the /change-log hub and runtime consumers through the release repository, with optional database projection after deploy sync.
Matched Newsroom hub interactions for search, filters, expand/collapse and hash deep links while keeping Blade and plain JS.
Kept guests free of internal-only notes; staff, volunteers and students retain gated internal detail.
Updated prepare, CI validation and Cloudron activate-release so GitHub notes and deploys use the current per-release file.
affected_areas: Release history authoring and CI validation
Cloudron deploy activation and rollback current selection
version_rationale: Minor: new per-release changelog capability and hub parity without breaking VERSION or module-runtime contract semantics.
validation: PHPUnit ReleaseEntryValidatorTest, ReleaseSchemaProjectionTest, ReleaseChangelogSyncTest, ReleaseHistoryConversionTest, ReleaseHistoryDatabaseConsumerTest, ChangeLogAudienceIsolationTest, ChangeLogPageTest.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after the release commit.
npm run test:frontend for change-log hash and filter behaviour.
known_limitations: resources/data/releases.json remains a generated compatibility artefact during transition and must not be hand-edited.
Database projection requires MYAPES_CHANGELOG_USE_DATABASE=true after a successful releases-sync on activate.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag. activate-release syncs that package's changelog files, sets current to its VERSION, and unpublishes newer-only projected rows without deleting them.
provenance: Epic #703 with children #704–#715; milestone PR #981 on branch milestone/v0-70-0-newsroom-style-changelog-hub.
